## GitLab MR review (starting point)

Same advisor as the GitHub variant, with GitLab nodes swapped in. Polling, because a local n8n can't receive GitLab webhooks.

Flow: Schedule -> List open MRs -> Get MR changes -> Build diff -> Prepare request -> **Review** -> Post review note.

`PROJECT_ID` = the URL-encoded path (e.g. `group%2Fproject`) or the numeric id. `PRIVATE-TOKEN` header-auth credential. Swap point = the *Review* node (agent today, human later).

Self-hosted GitLab: replace https://gitlab.com with your host.

assignments.name: body
assignments.value: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'openai/gpt-6-luna', messages: [ { role: 'system', content: 'You are an independent, read-only MR reviewer. Review the diff against this checklist: correctness and intent; tests and evidence; docs updated in the same commit; scope and contracts; simplicity and anti-slop (no dead code, unused deps, speculative abstraction); harness changes (flag AGENTS.md, .opencode/**, .claude/**, .github/**, .gitlab-ci.yml, scripts/*, pom.xml, CLAUDE.md); boundaries (no credentials). Cite path:line; separate verified from inference. Do not approve or merge. Output: first line VERDICT: approve | request-changes | comment; then CHECKLIST: item=pass|fail|n-a; then FINDINGS: - [severity] path:line - problem / fix.' }, { role: 'user', content: 'Diff: ' + $json.diff } ] }) }}

## SWAP POINT
Replace this node with a human step (email/Slack/MR review request) returning the same VERDICT/CHECKLIST/FINDINGS contract.
